title: The Sunday Read: ‘Laurie Anderson Has a Message for Us Humans’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访几位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能准时收看。

sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: One of the first times I met Laurie Anderson was at a benefit concert at Carnegie Hall.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到劳里·安德森是在卡内基音乐厅的一场慈善音乐会上。

sentences.en: It was late February 2020, which feels today like the innocent world of the before times.
sentences.zh: 那是2020年2月下旬，如今回想起来，那段时光仿佛是“前疫情时代”的纯真世界。

sentences.en: So I went to see Laurie set up for this show, and I remember getting there, and Carnegie Hall was completely empty,
sentences.zh: 当时我去看劳里为演出做准备，记得我到达时，卡内基音乐厅里空无一人，

sentences.en: except for the performers were all sort of setting up and getting ready.
sentences.zh: 只有表演者们在各自忙着布置和准备。

sentences.en: There was Philip Glass sitting at a grand piano, tinkling his little arpeggios, and they were all kind of taking turns.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·格拉斯坐在大钢琴前，弹奏着他那轻快的小琶音，大家都在轮流排练。

sentences.en: I remember the actress Sandra Oh came and really beautifully read this poem by Allen Ginsberg.
sentences.zh: 我记得演员吴珊卓也来了，她非常动情地朗诵了艾伦·金斯堡的一首诗。

sentences.en: And during all of this warming up, Laurie Anderson was by herself in the middle of the stage, down on her knees,
sentences.zh: 在这一切热身过程中，劳里·安德森独自一人跪在舞台中央，

sentences.en: setting up her very elaborate, kind of homemade musical rig that she uses for her performances, and has used for almost 50 years.
sentences.zh: 正在组装她那套极其复杂、半手工打造的音乐装置，那是她近50年来演出一直使用的设备。

sentences.en: All of these synthesizers and just instruments that can electronically simulate every kind of instrument you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 那上面全是合成器，还有各种能以电子方式模拟出你能想象到的任何乐器的设备。

sentences.en: The concert itself was amazing.
sentences.zh: 音乐会本身非常精彩。

sentences.en: Like, Patti Smith was there.
sentences.zh: 比如，帕蒂·史密斯也去了。

sentences.en: Laurie goes on, and she played From the Air, which is from her album Big Science.
sentences.zh: 劳里登台表演了《From the Air》，这首歌出自她的专辑《Big Science》。

sentences.en: It's this beautiful, intense song where she's got this orchestral sort of music, and she's doing this eerie monologue.
sentences.zh: 这是一首优美而强烈的歌曲，伴随着管弦乐般的音乐，她用一种诡异的语调进行独白。

sentences.en: She's saying, this is your captain, and we are all going down.
sentences.zh: 她说，这是你们的机长，我们都要坠机了。

sentences.en: And she's narrating a kind of plane crash that we are all a part of.
sentences.zh: 她讲述了一场我们每个人都身处其中的空难。

sentences.en: This is your captain.
sentences.zh: 这是你们的机长。

sentences.en: We are going down.
sentences.zh: 我们要坠机了。

sentences.en: We are all going down.
sentences.zh: 我们都要坠机了。

sentences.en: And she keeps repeating this haunting phrase.
sentences.zh: 她不断重复着这句令人难忘的话。

sentences.en: She keeps saying, this is the time, and this is the record of the time.
sentences.zh: 她一直在说，这就是时代，这就是时代的记录。

sentences.en: This is the time.
sentences.zh: 这就是时代。

sentences.en: The record.
sentences.zh: 记录。

sentences.en: Which, to me, has always been this great, mysterious bit of poetry that feels very modern.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这始终是一段充满神秘感的诗意表达，感觉非常现代。

sentences.en: It feels very 2021, in a way, where everything is recorded.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这感觉非常像2021年，一切都被记录在案。

sentences.en: Everything is kind of lived and recorded at the same time.
sentences.zh: 一切似乎都在经历的同时被记录了下来。

sentences.en: But I also remember looking around.
sentences.zh: 但我也记得我环顾四周时的情景。

sentences.en: It seemed to be a packed house.
sentences.zh: 当时座无虚席。

sentences.en: The pandemic was obviously in the news, this new coronavirus that was sweeping across the world
sentences.zh: 疫情显然已经成了新闻，这种席卷全球的新型冠状病毒，

sentences.en: and something we should probably be worried about, but how worried about, we weren't sure yet.
sentences.zh: 是我们应该担心的事，但到底该担心到什么程度，我们当时还不确定。

sentences.en: Do we need to be at home?
sentences.zh: 我们需要待在家里吗？

sentences.en: Are we allowed to do things like this anymore?
sentences.zh: 我们还能被允许参加这样的活动吗？

sentences.en: I remember that concert vividly as my first experience of that eerie feeling that we're all so familiar with now,
sentences.zh: 那场音乐会是我对那种诡异感觉的初次体验，而这种感觉我们现在都太熟悉了，

sentences.en: of wondering if we're in the right place, and if we're allowed to be surrounded by the people we're surrounded by.
sentences.zh: 就是那种怀疑自己是否身处正确的地方，以及是否被允许与周围的人待在一起的困惑。

sentences.en: You know, a couple weeks later, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，几周后，美国

sentences.en: went into lockdown.
sentences.zh: 进入了封锁状态。

sentences.en: That was my last event in the before times, in regular life.
sentences.zh: 那是我在“前疫情时代”、在正常生活中的最后一场活动。

sentences.en: My name is Sam Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我叫萨姆·安德森。

sentences.en: I am a staff writer for the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: And today, I'm going to read you a profile that I wrote about the artist Laurie Anderson.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将为您朗读我写的一篇关于艺术家劳里·安德森的人物专访。

sentences.en: I knew of Laurie Anderson, and I knew some of the other experimental work that she's done.
sentences.zh: 我了解劳里·安德森，也知道她做过的一些其他实验性作品。

sentences.en: But as soon as I started really getting into the research, I was totally blown away by how much I didn't know, and by just how much she's done in so many different fields.
sentences.zh: 但当我真正开始深入研究时，我完全被她的成就所震撼，也惊讶于她竟然在如此多的领域都有所建树。

sentences.en: And what struck me was just how unsummarizable her career was.
sentences.zh: 最让我印象深刻的是，她的职业生涯简直无法被概括。

sentences.en: I remember saying, actually, at one point to Laurie, I keep trying to get my arms all the way around your career, and I just can't do it.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次我对劳里说，我一直试图全面了解你的职业生涯，但我实在做不到。

sentences.en: I'm reading this stack of books, and I've watched all these films and videos, and it's really just, it's staggering, the amount of work that you've done.
sentences.zh: 我读了这一摞书，看了所有这些电影和视频，你所完成的作品数量真的令人震惊。

sentences.en: And she looked back at me, and she said, it is staggering.
sentences.zh: 她看着我说，确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: And so if you approach life that way, day after day after day, and your energy does not flag, which Laurie's energy never seems to somehow,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你日复一日地以这种方式生活，且精力从不衰减——劳里的精力似乎从未衰减过——

sentences.en: then suddenly you're in your 70s, and you've produced just this absolutely staggering amount of work that staggers even yourself.
sentences.zh: 那么当你到了70多岁时，你已经创作出了数量惊人的作品，甚至连你自己都会感到震惊。

sentences.en: So before I start reading my article, I thought I would share something that Laurie shared with me in one of our last conversations.
sentences.zh: 所以在开始朗读文章之前，我想分享一些劳里在我们最后几次谈话中告诉我的事情。

sentences.en: And it's sort of a test that she uses to figure out whether a piece that she's working on is good or not.
sentences.zh: 这算是她用来判断自己正在创作的作品是否优秀的一种测试方法。

sentences.en: And she said she thinks about this every single creative project, every single medium, whether it's a song or a painting or some kind of talking sculpture.
sentences.zh: 她说她会在每一个创意项目、每一种媒介中都考虑这一点，无论是歌曲、绘画还是某种会说话的雕塑。

sentences.en: And she listed for me five questions.
sentences.zh: 她列出了五个问题。

sentences.en: And they are, is it complicated enough?
sentences.zh: 它们是：它足够复杂吗？

sentences.en: Is it simple enough?
sentences.zh: 它足够简单吗？

sentences.en: Is it crazy enough?
sentences.zh: 它足够疯狂吗？

sentences.en: Is it beautiful enough?
sentences.zh: 它足够美吗？

sentences.en: And finally, is it stupid enough?
sentences.zh: 最后，它足够愚蠢吗？

sentences.en: And I thought that was just kind of a great criteria for proceeding in life with whatever you're doing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对于无论在生活中做什么事来说，都是一个很棒的准则。

sentences.en: So here's my article.
sentences.zh: 那么，这是我的文章。

sentences.en: When the Hirshhorn Museum told Laurie Anderson that it wanted to put on a big, lavish retrospective of her work, she said no.
sentences.zh: 当赫什霍恩博物馆告诉劳里·安德森，他们想为她的作品举办一场盛大而奢华的回顾展时，她拒绝了。

sentences.en: For one thing, she was busy.
sentences.zh: 首先，她很忙。

sentences.en: She has been busy now for roughly 50 years, hauling her keyboards and experimental violins all over the world to put on huge bonanzas of lasers and noise loops
sentences.zh: 她忙了大约50年了，带着她的键盘和实验小提琴奔波于世界各地，举办着充满激光和噪音循环的盛大演出，

sentences.en: and incantatory monologues that she delivers in a voice somewhere between slam poetry, an evening newscast, a final confession, and a bedtime story.
sentences.zh: 还有那些充满咒语般的独白，她用一种介于口语诗、晚间新闻、临终忏悔和睡前故事之间的声音娓娓道来。

sentences.en: Although Anderson plays multiple instruments, her signature tool has always been her voice.
sentences.zh: 尽管安德森演奏多种乐器，但她标志性的工具始终是她的声音。

sentences.en: Words emerge from her mouth, deliberate and hyper-enunciated, surrounded by unpredictable pauses.
sentences.zh: 词句从她口中吐出，深思熟虑且发音极其清晰，中间夹杂着难以预测的停顿。

sentences.en: She piles up phrases the way Van Gogh piled up brush strokes.
sentences.zh: 她堆砌词句的方式，就像梵高堆砌笔触一样。

sentences.en: Over the course of her incessant career,
sentences.zh: 在她那永不停歇的职业生涯中，

sentences.en: Anderson has done just about everything a creative person can do.
sentences.zh: 安德森几乎尝试过一个创作者所能做的一切。

sentences.en: She has helped design an Olympics opening ceremony, served as the official artist-in-residence for NASA, made an opera out of Moby Dick,
sentences.zh: 她曾协助设计奥运会开幕式，担任过美国国家航空航天局（NASA）的官方驻留艺术家，将《白鲸记》改编成歌剧，

sentences.en: and played a concert for dogs at the Sydney Opera House.
sentences.zh: 还在悉尼歌剧院为狗狗们举办过音乐会。

sentences.en: She has danced the tango with William S.
sentences.zh: 她曾与威廉·S·巴勒斯跳过探戈，

sentences.en: Burroughs and flown to a tropical island with John Cage, and she is still going.
sentences.zh: 与约翰·凯奇飞往热带岛屿，而且她至今仍在不断前行。

sentences.en: As Anderson once put it to me, during a brief pause between trips to Paris and New Zealand, just before a Carnegie Hall performance with Iggy Pop,
sentences.zh: 正如安德森在巴黎和新西兰之行间的短暂间隙，在与伊基·波普于卡内基音乐厅演出前夕对我所说的那样，

sentences.en: lately I'm doing a stupid amount of things.
sentences.zh: 最近我做的事情多得离谱。

sentences.en: On top of all this,
sentences.zh: 除此之外，

sentences.en: Anderson had philosophical qualms about a retrospective.
sentences.zh: 安德森对举办回顾展心存哲学上的顾虑。

sentences.en: She is 74, which seems like a very normal age to stop and look back, and yet she seems determined, at all times, to keep moving forward.
sentences.zh: 她今年74岁了，这似乎是一个停下来回顾往事的正常年纪，但她似乎时刻都下定决心要继续向前。

sentences.en: She is a perpetually cresting wave, a little green shoot constantly emerging from its seed.
sentences.zh: 她就像一道永不停歇的浪潮，又像一颗不断破土而出的嫩芽。

sentences.en: The last thing she wanted was to stop and stand still and be institutionalized in a big museum.
sentences.zh: 她最不想做的就是停下脚步，被束之高阁，陈列在大型博物馆里。

sentences.en: This is the paradox of Laurie Anderson.
sentences.zh: 这就是劳里·安德森的悖论。

sentences.en: What makes her worthy of a retrospective also makes her basically retrospective-proof.
sentences.zh: 让她值得举办回顾展的特质，也让她本质上成为了“回顾展绝缘体”。

sentences.en: Anderson's response to the Hirshhorn was a counter-proposal.
sentences.zh: 安德森对赫什霍恩博物馆的回应是一个反向提议。

sentences.en: How about a show of entirely new work?
sentences.zh: 不如办一个全是新作的展览如何？

sentences.en: In some ways, I wasn't surprised,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，我并不感到惊讶，

sentences.en: Melissa Chu, the museum's director, told me.
sentences.zh: 博物馆馆长梅丽莎·朱告诉我。

sentences.en: She's so interested in the here and now.
sentences.zh: 她对当下的一切非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: We had to make peace with that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须接受这一点。

sentences.en: We made a decision early on to say, okay, Laurie's got this.
sentences.zh: 我们很早就决定了，好吧，让劳里自己来主导。

sentences.en: The Hirshhorn gave Anderson the whole second floor and then followed her lead.
sentences.zh: 赫什霍恩博物馆把整个二楼都交给了安德森，并跟随她的节奏行事。

sentences.en: There were a few exceptions.
sentences.zh: 当然也有一些例外。

sentences.en: When Anderson proposed filling part of a room with stinky wet mud, the museum, citing policy, said no.
sentences.zh: 当安德森提议用又臭又湿的泥土填满部分展厅时，博物馆以相关政策为由拒绝了。

sentences.en: The result is a show called The Weather, a sort of non-retrospective retrospective of one of America's major and majorly confounding modern artists.
sentences.zh: 最终呈现的展览名为《天气》，这是一场非回顾展式的回顾展，展出的是美国最重要、也最令人困惑的现代艺术家之一的作品。

sentences.en: Chu says the show is less a traditional exhibition than a giant artist's project that happens to be set in our National Museum of Modern Art.
sentences.zh: 朱馆长说，与其说这是一场传统展览，不如说是一个巨大的艺术家项目，恰好落户在我们的国家现代艺术博物馆中。

sentences.en: The Hirshhorn sits right on the National Mall, midway between the Washington Monument and the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 赫什霍恩博物馆坐落在国家广场上，位于华盛顿纪念碑和国会大厦之间。

sentences.en: This makes it the perfect site to showcase Anderson's work.
sentences.zh: 这使它成为展示安德森作品的绝佳地点。

sentences.en: She has always been obsessed with America.
sentences.zh: 她一直对美国有着某种执念。

sentences.en: Her whole career, as she describes it, has been an attempt to tell and retell the national story.
sentences.zh: 正如她所描述的，她的整个职业生涯都是在试图讲述并重述这个国家的故事。

sentences.en: This is, of course, a fraught, impossible project.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一个充满矛盾且不可能完成的任务。

sentences.en: But then Anderson is a fraught, impossible storyteller.
sentences.zh: 但安德森本身就是一位充满矛盾、难以捉摸的叙事者。

sentences.en: Americans have traditionally demanded coherent and simple national stories, she has written.
sentences.zh: 她曾写道，美国人历来要求国家故事既连贯又简单。

sentences.en: Now, many of these stories no longer make any sense.
sentences.zh: 如今，许多这样的故事已不再有任何意义。

sentences.en: But so far, nothing has replaced them.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，还没有任何东西能取代它们。

sentences.en: We are in story limbo.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于故事的真空期。

sentences.en: And for a storyteller, this is an intensely interesting place to be.
sentences.zh: 而对于一个叙事者来说，这是一个极其有趣的状态。

sentences.en: Anderson's stories tend to be broken and fragmented, unfinished, non-linear, elusive, pointless.
sentences.zh: 安德森的故事往往是破碎的、零散的、未完成的、非线性的、难以捉摸且毫无意义的。

sentences.en: Stories about the impossibility of stories.
sentences.zh: 那是关于“故事本身无法成立”的故事。

sentences.en: They are often gender-fluid.
sentences.zh: 它们通常具有性别流动性。

sentences.en: She appears sometimes as a character called Fenway Bergamot, a male alter ego with thick eyebrows and a mustache.
sentences.zh: 她有时会化身为一个叫芬威·佛手柑的角色，一个留着浓眉和胡须的男性替身。

sentences.en: In place of coherence, in place of the machine logic of propaganda,
sentences.zh: 为了取代连贯性，为了取代宣传机器的逻辑，

sentences.en: Anderson inserts dream logic, joke logic, the self-swallowing logic of Buddhism.
sentences.zh: 安德森植入了梦境逻辑、笑话逻辑，以及佛教中那种自我消解的逻辑。

sentences.en: She likes to hollow out triumphant national stories and fill them with doubt.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢掏空那些胜利的国家叙事，并往里填入怀疑。

sentences.en: She once summarized the Star-Spangled Banner, for instance, as just a lot of questions asked during a fire.
sentences.zh: 例如，她曾将《星条旗》总结为：不过是在火光中提出的一连串问题。

sentences.en: Say, isn't that a flag?
sentences.zh: “喂，那不是一面旗帜吗？”

sentences.en: She asked, pointing into the distance.
sentences.zh: 她指着远处问道。

sentences.en: Couldn't say, she answered.
sentences.zh: “说不好，”她回答道。

sentences.en: It's pretty early in the morning.
sentences.zh: “现在还是清晨呢。”

sentences.en: Chu told me, with what sounded like a mixture of awe and anxiety, that she could imagine
sentences.zh: 朱馆长带着一种敬畏与焦虑交织的语气告诉我，她甚至能想象出

sentences.en: Anderson wanting to change the Hirshhorn show even after it was installed.
sentences.zh: 安德森在展览布置好之后还想做出改动。

sentences.en: I asked Anderson if she could see herself doing this.
sentences.zh: 我问安德森是否真的会这么做。

sentences.en: Absolutely, she said.
sentences.zh: “当然，”她说。

sentences.en: In fact, she was planning on it.

sentences.en: Lori is a total nightmare for every gallerist, she said.

sentences.zh: 一个冬日，

sentences.en: Anderson invited me to her studio at the end of Canal Street, right where it meets the Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 安德森邀请我去她位于运河街尽头的工作室，就在它与哈德逊河交汇的地方。

sentences.en: She has been working here since the 1970s, since the downtown glory days of Warhol,
sentences.zh: 她从 20 世纪 70 年代起就在这里工作了，那是安迪·沃霍尔（Warhol）的市中心辉煌时代，

sentences.zh: 巴斯奎特（Basquiat），

sentences.zh: 我坐在那儿，抚摸着她那只毛茸茸的梗犬，

sentences.zh: 小威尔（Little Will），而安德森则跟我谈论着宇宙中的万事万物。

sentences.zh: 她跟我讲了小马的事。

sentences.en: And donkeys.

sentences.zh: “它们拥有动物王国里最好的记忆力。”

sentences.en: Not the elegant, tropical, wiggly jewels that you tend to see in aquariuMs.

sentences.en: I had come prepared with a notebook full of nervous, sweaty questions.
sentences.zh: 我来的时候准备了一个笔记本，上面写满了紧张、冒汗的问题。

sentences.en: Because Anderson is an icon of the avant-garde.
sentences.zh: 因为安德森是前卫艺术的偶像。

sentences.en: A titan and a pioneer.
sentences.zh: 一位泰斗，一位先驱。

sentences.en: And her career is so staggeringly full and deep and weird that my brain kept breaking whenever I tried to think about it.
sentences.zh: 她的职业生涯如此令人震惊地丰富、深邃且古怪，以至于每当我试图思考它时，我的大脑就会宕机。

sentences.en: But my questions turned out to be unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，我的问题是多余的。

sentences.en: Anderson is maybe the easiest person to talk to I have ever met.
sentences.zh: 安德森可能是我见过最容易交谈的人。

sentences.en: A conversation with her is self-propelling and unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 与她的谈话是自我推进且不可预测的。

sentences.en: An instant flood of ideas and funny stories and book recommendations and factoids.
sentences.zh: 瞬间涌现出各种想法、有趣的故事、书籍推荐和冷知识。

sentences.en: Did you know that a mosquito in really bad storms can hang on to a raindrop and ride safely toward the ground?
sentences.zh: “你知道吗？蚊子在暴风雨中可以抓住雨滴，安全地降落到地面。”

sentences.en: Anderson will pause to show you viral videos on her phone and websites on her laptop.
sentences.zh: 安德森会停下来，在手机上给你看病毒式传播的视频，在笔记本电脑上给你看网页。

sentences.zh: 或者，“你是怎么处理那个的？”

sentences.en: Or, do you think so?
sentences.zh: 或者，“你这么认为吗？”

sentences.en: And then she will actually listen to the answers.
sentences.zh: 然后她会认真地听你的回答。

sentences.en: Because of the circles she moves in, even the most basic stories about her life can sound like outrageous name-dropping.

sentences.zh: 引用如下：“你不会告诉别人你的银行账户里有多少钱。”

sentences.en: It's the last taboo.
sentences.zh: “这是最后的禁忌。”

sentences.en: At one point, she was reminiscing about Alice Waters, an old friend, when suddenly her phone rang and the caller ID actually said right out loud,
sentences.zh: 有一次，她正在回忆老朋友爱丽丝·沃特斯（Alice Waters），突然她的电话响了，来电显示上赫然写着：

sentences.en: Julian Schnabel.
sentences.zh: 朱利安·施纳贝尔（Julian Schnabel）。

sentences.en: That's what it's like to be around Anderson.
sentences.zh: 这就是待在安德森身边的感觉。

sentences.en: I'm a really blabby person, she told me.
sentences.zh: “我是一个很爱唠叨的人，”她告诉我。

sentences.en: I learn about things by talking about them.
sentences.zh: “我通过谈论事物来学习它们。”

sentences.en: After a few minutes, however, the conversation paused.
sentences.zh: 然而几分钟后，谈话中断了。

sentences.en: Anderson asked if I would mind helping her carry some stuff down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 安德森问我是否介意帮她把一些东西搬下楼。

sentences.en: She had to rehearse later with a cellist she'd been improvising with.
sentences.zh: 她稍后要和一位一直与她即兴创作的大提琴手排练。

sentences.en: Of course not, I said.
sentences.zh: “当然不介意，”我说。

sentences.en: Anderson is small and slim and slight, a sort of national heritage site of a human being, and I told her I would be happy to haul whatever needed hauling.
sentences.zh: 安德森身材娇小、纤细，简直就像人类的国家级遗产，我告诉她，我很乐意搬运任何需要搬运的东西。

sentences.zh: “这个怎么样？”她说。

sentences.zh: 她递给我一根整齐盘绕的小电线。

sentences.zh: “还有这个，”她递给我第二根线。

sentences.zh: 我拿着我的两根线跟在她后面。

sentences.en: It became clear to me that she hadn't needed my help at all.
sentences.zh: 我清楚地意识到，她根本不需要我的帮助。

sentences.en: She just had something to do, and she wanted to keep moving while we talked.
sentences.zh: 她只是有事要做，而且想在我们谈话时保持走动。

sentences.en: One floor down in her music studio,
sentences.zh: 在下一层的音乐工作室里，

sentences.zh: 安德森把黑箱子重重地放下。

sentences.zh: 她跪下打开它，露出一整窝科幻风格的设备。

sentences.en: Keyboards, in her music studio, metal frames, a shipyard's worth of cords and wires.
sentences.zh: 键盘、金属框架，还有堆得像造船厂一样的电线和缆线。

sentences.en: This, broken into pieces, was her performance rig, a big block of gear that she has assembled and disassembled and hauled across the world infinite times.
sentences.zh: 这拆解开来就是她的演出装备，一大堆她组装、拆卸并无数次运往世界各地的器材。

sentences.en: For the next
sentences.zh: 在接下来的

sentences.zh: 没过多久，

sentences.zh: 安德森就搭建起了一个多层结构的屏幕和键盘架构。

sentences.zh: 有一个完整的键盘是专门留给她的脚用的。

sentences.en: She seemed to be marshalling whole armies of instruments, lining them up in different formations, setting them against one another.
sentences.zh: 她似乎在指挥着整支乐器大军，将它们排列成不同的阵型，让它们相互对抗。

sentences.en: Anderson has been perfecting her command center for decades now, streamlining it and juicing up its weird powers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，安德森一直在完善她的指挥中心，精简它并增强其奇异的能量。

sentences.zh: 看着她让这一切活过来，感觉不像是在看音乐家准备排练，而更像是一种宗教仪式、一种修行、一种纪律。

sentences.zh: 这些设备及其发出的声音似乎深入了她的骨髓和灵魂。
